name: Horizon Zero Dawn Volumetric Cloud System
aliases: Procedural Volumetric Clouds for Horizon Zero Dawn
definition: A real-time volumetric cloud rendering system for Horizon Zero Dawn that uses layered procedural noise stored in 3D and 2D textures to generate cloud shapes, lighting, and turbulence, replacing asset-based billboards and sky domes.
summary: The Horizon Zero Dawn Volumetric Cloud System is a real-time procedural method using Perlin-Worley noise to generate realistic, evolving cloudscapes with inter-cloud shadowing, overcoming the limitations of asset-based sky domes.
